title: Rafael and the Ghost
author: Marguerite Blackwood
blurb: Paloma Ishikawa, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
